freight_diff":null,"product_category_name":"livros_interesse_geral","value":23.355,"window_items":2,"window_share":0.0024},{"baseline":null,"baseline_items":null,"baseline_share":null,"freight_diff":null,"product_category_name":"construcao_ferramentas_seguranca","value":26.11,"window_items":2,"window_share":0.0024},{"baseline":null,"baseline_items":null,"baseline_share":null,"freight_diff":null,"product_category_name":"instrumentos_musicais","value":17.915,"window_items":2,"window_share":0.0024},{"baseline":null,"baseline_items":null,"baseline_share":null,"freight_diff":null,"product_category_name":"sinalizacao_e_seguranca","value":31.7,"window_items":2,"window_share":0.0024},{"baseline":null,"baseline_items":null,"baseline_share":null,"freight_diff":null,"product_category_name":"fashion_roupa_masculina","value":36.09,"window_items":1,"window_share":0.0012},{"baseline":null,"baseline_items":null,"baseline_share":null,"freight_diff":null,"product_category_name":"cine_foto","value":25.64,"window_items":1,"window_share":0.0012},{"baseline":null,"baseline_items":null,"baseline_share":null,"freight_diff":null,"product_category_name":"artigos_de_festas","value":40.39,"window_items":1,"window_share":0.0012}],"rows_returned":50,"sql":"WITH rj_items AS (
  SELECT
    oi.freight_value,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp,
    p.product_category_name,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-08-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01' THEN 'window'
      WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-08-01' THEN 'baseline'
    END AS period
  FROM orders.order_items oi
  JOIN orders.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN orders.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN orders.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-07-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01'
),
cat_stats AS (
  SELECT
    product_category_name,
    period,
    COUNT(*) AS n_items,
    AVG(freight_value) AS avg_freight
  FROM rj_items
  WHERE period IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY product_category_name, period
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    period,
    COUNT(*) AS total_items
  FROM rj_items
  WHERE period IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY period
),
cat_pivot AS (
  SELECT
    product_category_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN n_items END) AS window_items,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN n_items END) AS baseline_items,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN avg_freight END) AS value,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN avg_freight END) AS baseline
  FROM cat_stats
  GROUP BY product_category_name
)
SELECT
  cp.product_category_name,
  cp.window_items,
  cp.baseline_items,
  ROUND(CAST(cp.window_items AS DOUBLE) / wt.total_items, 4) AS window_share,
  ROUND(CAST(cp.baseline_items AS DOUBLE) / bt.total_items, 4) AS baseline_share,
  ROUND(cp.value, 4) AS value,
  ROUND(cp.baseline, 4) AS baseline,
  ROUND(cp.value - cp.baseline, 4) AS freight_diff
FROM cat_pivot cp
CROSS JOIN (SELECT total_items FROM totals WHERE period = 'window') wt
CROSS JOIN (SELECT total_items FROM totals WHERE period = 'baseline') bt
ORDER BY ABS(cp.value - cp.baseline) DESC NULLS LAST, cp.window_items DESC
LIMIT 50;","task":{"family":"mix_shift","id":"H2","kind":"hypothesis","statement":"The product or seller mix shifted toward categories or origins with higher freight, raising the average for RJ orders.","test":{"description":"Follow-up requested by the Critic: Measure product-category order shares and average freight_value per category for RJ orders in window 2018-08-01/2018-09-01 versus baseline 2018-07-01/2018-08-01.","sources":["orders.order_items","orders.orders","orders.customers","orders.products"]}},"truncated":false}
